annotations.title: Screen purchase lines against banned-vendor lists

description: Score up to 2,000 vendor payment or purchase-order lines (vendor, description, amount, date YYYY-MM-DD, award number, funding source) against the DoD 1260H, Section 889, FCC Covered, UFLPA and BIOSECURE lists as they stood on each line's date. Resolves resellers by product name (DNBSEQ flow cells, DJI Mavic/Matrice, Hikvision DS-2CD, TP-Link Omada). Each hit gets per-rule status (Section 889 grants ban, American Security Drone Act sec. 1825, BIOSECURE grace, UFLPA import presumption, Section 805 for DoD funds) and, when the award number is in the ledger, the award's own paper evidence. Pass institution (name or UEI) to list the ledger awards with papers naming a vendor but no matching line. Nothing is stored. Free.
name: exposure_screen_purchases
title: Screen purchase lines against banned-vendor lists
